coupling: The segment-merging commit adds a direct copy for memory streams, guarded by an exact remaining-byte check. The later size-check commit permits a declared segment to exceed the remaining bytes by one. Either edit alone remains memory-safe: the unchanged exact check protects the direct copy, while the original FT_STREAM_READ rejects an overlong segment even with the relaxed check. Together they copy one byte beyond the caller-owned PFB buffer. Repair requires checking the later length rule against the earlier memory-stream copy path, not reviewing either diff in isolation.
